featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrendous Experience: Extortion, Scams, and Absolute Lack of Professionalism
​I had the worst experience at this Royal Enfield service center. For a bill of nearly ₹9,000, the level of service, care, and transparency was sub-zero. Here is a breakdown of why you should avoid this place:
​Zero Accountability & Delays: Dropped my bike off with promises of same-day or next-day delivery. I received zero updates on Sunday and Monday. When I followed up on Tuesday, I was ghosted, told advisors were unavailable, and given the runaround.
​The Anti-Rust Coating Scam: I was pushed into taking a ₹1,000 anti-rust coating. When I went to pick up the bike, it was covered in dust and the coating wasn't even done. After calling them out, they "applied" it in front of me: a transparent liquid filled in a ₹10 Thums Up bottle, dabbed onto my bike's chrome with a torn, dirty rag. It is a complete scam.
​Horrible Handling of the Vehicle: While trying to find my bike's keys, the staff literally jammed 2–3 random keys into the ignition, tussling with it carelessly.
